claim_text: A longhorn seen over Fort Worth and Dallas, and the sea.
quote: I see a longhorn cattle over Fort Worth, Texas and Dallas
falsify_match: An event centred on the Texas cattle industry.
falsify_miss: Nothing follows. The longhorn is the state emblem, which makes it a label for Texas rather than a detail.

claim_text: Unsaved militias and complete anarchy in America like Red Dawn with even the Mississippi taken over, Texas separated and fighting for survival, which he compares to the EMP novel and hopes is the tribulation rather than now.
quote: It looks like complete anarchy in America
falsify_match: State collapse with armed groups holding territory.
falsify_miss: No collapse. He places it in the tribulation himself, which removes any near-term bound.

claim_text: Reassurance about the economy offered for the midterms while the beast system comes into play, with the Middle East rising under MBS and Iraq and others in a brotherhood, and his son showing him his own earlier words about the oil wealth.
quote: I saw the Middle East rising up with MBS
falsify_match: A formal Gulf and Iraqi bloc under Saudi leadership.
falsify_miss: No bloc forms. His son producing the earlier clips is how these confirmations are assembled.

claim_text: Great fountains of wealth from the Middle East with Babylon rising again, financial blessing through Saudi oil, and Saudi Arabia going alongside crypto with new legislation and joining a blockchain.
quote: I saw Babylon rising again
falsify_match: Saudi crypto legislation and a sovereign blockchain position.
falsify_miss: None. Gulf sovereign crypto interest was already reported before this.

claim_text: Virgin sacrifices seen in Germany around Berlin, with an attempt to bring forth the Mahdi and a Hitler spirit over Europe with major war, and World War III over Europe, which he ties to a visitation in which Jesus stood in his house with three angels.
quote: trying to bring forth the Mahdi this spirit like a Hitler spirit
falsify_match: A European war beginning with a figure rising out of Germany.
falsify_miss: No such war. He corrects himself from Iran to Germany mid-sentence, which is worth noting.

claim_text: Something happening to the American leader while Macron and the Russian government were negotiating, with the Secret Service unable to see where it came from and panicking, followed immediately by a major war across Europe as retaliation because of what he has set in place if anything happens to him.
quote: It was a retaliation immediately for what just happened to our leader
falsify_match: An attack on the president followed by an American strike on Europe.
falsify_miss: No attack. A standing retaliation order of that kind is the mechanism he supplies, and it is not a documented arrangement.

claim_text: He defends taking the call to intercede for the president seriously, for his children, his marriage and his health, saying the Lord told him the man cannot do this alone and must be carried over the threshold into the end zone.
quote: carry him over the threshold into the end zone
falsify_match: Not applicable; a statement of assignment.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it makes the outcome of the presidency conditional on the prayers of the audience.

claim_text: The five major shakings arriving at once, with talk of a great recession or depression, which he says is all by design because a one world digital currency is needed that will be scanned in the arm, hand or forehead to buy anything.
quote: This is all by design
falsify_match: An implanted or scanned payment identifier becoming compulsory.
falsify_miss: No compulsion. He gives the timing as five, two or seven years and says he does not know, which removes any bound.

claim_text: He says there are things he is instructed not to talk about that sit on him like a thousand pound weight until he gets through them in prayer, and that he already knows what is coming for America and the world.
quote: there's some things that you can't talk about
falsify_match: Not applicable; an account of withholding.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. This is the standing explanation for why the sharpest material is not given.

claim_text: Prayer over Marco Rubio and over Cuba, declaring that Cuba's day of deliverance is at hand, with the horns heard again.
quote: CUBA, YOUR DAY OF DELIVERANCE is at hand
falsify_match: The Cuban government falling.
falsify_miss: It holds. At hand carries no date.

claim_text: The sound of an abundance of rain declared over Cuba, Venezuela, Brazil, Argentina and Colombia, with a great shaking to awaken coming to South America.
quote: A great shaking TO AWAKEN IS COMING TO SOUTH AMERICA
falsify_match: A continent-wide religious movement in South America.
falsify_miss: Growth continues at the existing rate, which has been high for decades.

claim_text: Prayer for Lindell's health and for the greatest red wave ever seen over Minnesota, a red wave over California with voter fraud uncovered and brought to justice, and the Save America Act passed without further hesitation.
quote: THE GREATEST RED WAVE OVER MINNESOTA WE'VE EVER SEEN
falsify_match: Republican sweeps in Minnesota and California.
falsify_miss: Neither state swings. Both are among the least likely in the country, which is the base rate.

claim_text: A dark principality-looking figure holding up the Save America Act, located toward Pennsylvania and New York, black, and connected to funding.
quote: There is a principality-looking figure that is holding this up
falsify_match: Named donors shown to be blocking the legislation.
falsify_miss: No such showing. He locates it geographically but names nobody.

claim_text: Billions of dollars of wealth influencing politicians as the reason the Save America Act has not passed, described as the root of the fruit, with the body of Christ needing to rise up with money to counter it.
quote: I see great wealth, billions of dollars influencing politicians
falsify_match: Lobbying expenditure identified against the bill at that scale.
falsify_miss: Disclosed lobbying on the measure is far below billions, which is the figure he gives.

claim_text: Canada and France seen with Carney's face, bankers and great wealth behind the blocking, and a demonic spirit like a bull with horns standing on two legs like a matador, completely blacked out.
quote: It look like a bull with horns. But it's on two legs
falsify_match: Canadian or French financing traced to opposition to the American bill.
falsify_miss: No such financing. The bull on two legs is the same figure he gave the day before with the nose ring.

claim_text: The demonic spirit over the votes seen as a triangle running from New York to Canada and Toronto, into England and France, and back again.
quote: It's a triangle that goes from there to Canada to Toronto
falsify_match: A funding network across those four places opposing the bill.
falsify_miss: None identified. The triangle recurs with his Toronto pyramid material, which links the two images.

claim_text: The blockage described as a wall in the spirit, an Illuminati wall, with a declaration that the Save America Act will be pushed through.
quote: It's that Illuminati wall. I see a wall
falsify_match: The Act passing.
falsify_miss: It does not pass. The declaration is stated as an outcome, which makes it scoreable on the legislation.

claim_text: The bull with two feet feeding on babies, on the blood of the womb, the mother and the baby, called sacrifice and witchcraft, running from New York to Canada and Toronto and over to France, given as the root cause of the blocking.
quote: this bull it feeds on the babies
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. The causal claim is spiritual rather than financial, though he pairs it with the funding one.

claim_text: The same bull passage repeated with the blood and the route through Toronto to France.
quote: It's the blood of the womb
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; repetition within the stream.

claim_text: Dates flipping like a counter back to the 1500s seen behind the stronghold, followed by a long passage in tongues.
quote: I see 1500s
falsify_match: Not checkable; a dating of a spiritual stronghold.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. The century is the only concrete element and it points backwards rather than forwards.

claim_text: The root of saving America given as the blood of the innocent unborn crying out, described as an occultic and satanic ritual, running into California and to the one who slithers with a mask.
quote: the blood of the innocent cries out before me
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable, though it connects the abortion material to the Newsom serpent image.

claim_text: After a long passage in tongues he states that no Save America Act will save America, only Jesus, and that the Lord told him he is the only one who will save it, through a nation turning back to him.
quote: A save America act won't save America
falsify_match: The Act passing and making no difference.
falsify_miss: Not measurable. He has just declared the Act will be pushed through and here says it would not matter, which is worth keeping side by side.

claim_text: The glory returning to the churches on the Welsh pattern, emptying the bars and clubs and places of partying, across the land, Europe and Africa, as the only thing that will save the land.
quote: I empty the bars I'll empty the clubs
falsify_match: A measurable fall in alcohol and nightlife trade attributed to religious revival.
falsify_miss: No such fall. The Welsh precedent gives a historical benchmark that would be visible if met.

claim_text: He summarises: a demonic stronghold dating from the 1500s or earlier attached to Europe and running to Canada, with bats on the roof of a house and masked people making sacrifices for financial gain to a spirit that demands them through abortion.
quote: a stronghold with from the 1500s plus
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. Sacrifices for financial gain is the accusation, and it is made against unnamed masked figures.

claim_text: He repeats that the root going to the fruit of revival is what he was shown, and that what saves America is an awakening rather than the Act.
quote: an awakening under God will save America
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; the summary restated.

claim_text: Only a church with a backbone preaching Holy Ghost and fire will save America, not Trump and not the Act, with revival in Minnesota and California, and he says he is not satisfied with what has been prayed so far and asks for the pastors to be stirred.
quote: Not Trump, not Save America Act, but revival
falsify_match: Revival in the two named states.
falsify_miss: None. Naming Minnesota and California is consistent with the greater-the-blue rule.

claim_text: Prayer for the Jews, the synagogues and the Jewish communities around New York and Boston around this time frame, that there be no terrorism, no mass shootings, no pots with explosive devices and no drones assigned to anybody.
quote: I pray around the Jewish communities around New York, around Boston
falsify_match: An attack on a Jewish community in either city.
falsify_miss: No attack. Pots with explosive devices is the specific method named.

claim_text: He points to Japan approving a bill recognising cryptocurrency as a financial asset as the fulfilment of the Sooners word that Japan and South Korea would implement before America, with the Boomer Sooner wagon as the image.
quote: Japan will be the sooner concerning crypto
falsify_match: Japanese and Korean crypto legislation preceding American equivalents.
falsify_miss: America legislates first. Japan had already regulated crypto exchanges since 2017, so being ahead is the standing position rather than a change.

claim_text: The Japanese bill shown on screen as the word coming to pass, with a caution that many such articles are scams but this one is good.
quote: Japan officially approves bill to recognize cryptocurrency
falsify_match: As above.
falsify_miss: As above; the article is the confirmation being offered.

claim_text: He says he gave that the president would say he is full of peace but that God would use him to crack the whip and shake the nations, with all gloves off because he cannot be president again, and that he said the man would go after Venezuela first and then Iran.
quote: he'll go after Venezuela and then he's going to go after Iran
falsify_match: The earlier recordings containing the Venezuela then Iran sequence before both happened.
falsify_miss: The order is wrong or the recordings are later. He invites viewers to check the videos, which is the right test and can be run against this corpus.

claim_text: He says it happened exactly as given: drill baby drill, Iran taken back to the stone age, people buying oil from America and the economy booming, with everyone coming to buy.
quote: it happened exactly the way the Lord said
falsify_match: The sequence occurring as described and in the order given in advance.
falsify_miss: Any leg out of order or absent. This is the largest fulfilment claim in the corpus and it is checkable against the earlier tellings on file.

claim_text: Oil in the Gulf of America and coming out of Houston, pipelines opened and major pipelines re-established, oil flowing from Canada, and a stronger economy, which he says he gave in advance.
quote: I saw pipelines being opened up
falsify_match: Pipeline capacity actually added and Canadian flows rising.
falsify_miss: Capacity stays flat. Drill baby drill was administration policy from the start, which is the priority problem throughout this passage.

claim_text: He reads that the American military will begin a blockade of all shipping to and from Iran on the Monday, and asks where the ships will go.
quote: it will start blockade of all ships going to and from Iran
falsify_match: A naval blockade of Iran beginning on that Monday.
falsify_miss: No blockade. This is a same-day news item rather than a vision, and he presents it as what the Lord said would happen.

claim_text: Tanker traffic shown heading to America rather than Hormuz, and he recalls saying America would establish itself strongly in the Panama Canal and have great oil out of Houston and the Gulf.
quote: We are going to establish ourselves very strong in the Panama Canal
falsify_match: American control or dominant position at the Panama Canal.
falsify_miss: No such position. Panama Canal policy was already a public administration priority when this was given.

claim_text: He says the president has pulled off the largest shift in global power ever, burning down the competition so that America is open for business with tankers arriving in droves, and that this was plan B after the terrorists fell.
quote: the largest shift in global power ever
falsify_match: A measurable shift in global energy trade toward American supply.
falsify_miss: Trade patterns hold. He is quoting a social media post rather than describing a vision here.

claim_text: Great antisemitism in the media and in public with Jews blamed for oil, gas and food prices, Orthodox Jews unable to go out without being persecuted almost to death, rocks thrown at them in Europe, Philadelphia, New York and Chicago, and families uprooting and moving back to Israel and taking over Gaza.
quote: they will blame the Jews for the oil prices
falsify_match: Street violence against identifiable Jews in those cities driving emigration to Israel.
falsify_miss: Incidents stay at the current level and emigration stays low. Aliyah from America has been in the low thousands per year, which is the number that would have to move.

claim_text: A Trump golf course coming to Gaza with buildings built and a new Gaza, and a vast amount of oil in the Mediterranean just outside worth billions, with a certain oil company becoming very wealthy, and the antisemitism bringing the Jews home as fulfilment of prophecy.
quote: I saw a Trump golf course coming to the Gaza
falsify_match: A golf course and development built in Gaza with offshore production alongside.
falsify_miss: Neither. The Gaza redevelopment concept had been publicly floated in 2025, which is where the golf course image comes from.

claim_text: After Iran gets its hand out of Babylon, Babylon rises out of nowhere with Saudi Arabia becoming a major leader under MBS who brings a two-state solution with Jared, and he points to Saudi restoring the East-West pipeline bypassing the strait at seven million barrels a day.
quote: a two-state solution with Jared
falsify_match: A two-state agreement brokered by the Saudi crown prince with Jared Kushner involved.
falsify_miss: No agreement. Naming the broker and the intermediary makes this one of the more specific Middle East claims in the corpus.

claim_text: Saudi Arabia becoming friends with Iraq as Iraq rises out of the ashes, freed from Iranian influence, with oil pumping and Saudi becoming very wealthy, and he repeats that he believes there is a great opportunity that MBS could be the antichrist, adding that he could be wrong.
quote: there's a great opportunity that that man could be the Antichrist
falsify_match: The named man taking the role his eschatology describes.
falsify_miss: He does not. He hedges here with could I be wrong, yes, which is softer than the earlier flat identification.

claim_text: A major Miami pastor with a huge church contacting him after he called it out in prayer, saying he has meetings with people named, and a repeated statement that Cuba, Venezuela, Colombia, Brazil and Argentina will have major revivals.
quote: Cuba will be saved. Cuba's going to have a major revival
falsify_match: Revival across the named countries with the Miami church at its centre.
falsify_miss: None. The private confirmation he cites cannot be checked because he says he lacks permission to describe it.

claim_text: He describes public figures praying in tongues on camera and people falling out, says he believes it could happen, but that even that will not save America without an awakening and preachers preaching repentance and holiness.
quote: even then, it will not save America
falsify_match: Public figures manifesting in that way.
falsify_miss: They do not. He sets the bar above any political or celebrity conversion, which is consistent with the rest of the session.

claim_text: He says ego is a destroyer and that he will never let the ministry be for ego, and describes one of the largest churches in America offering him money and a home for his family, which he did not take.
quote: one of the largest churches in America offered me finances
falsify_match: Not applicable; an account of an offer.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it is worth recording alongside the giving material and the refusal to charge for books.

claim_text: Teaching that the word changes people from the inside so that old attractions fade, followed by the observation that this week will be interesting with the strait, and that both the Clarity Act and the Save America Act need passing as soon as possible, with Mike Lindell shown campaigning in Minnesota.
quote: There's two bills that need to be passed ASAP
falsify_match: Both bills passing.
falsify_miss: Neither passes. Two named pieces of legislation makes this checkable on the congressional record.

claim_text: Prayer over the first lady and the marriage, that the walls the devil is building be torn down and that division and strife not stand, since a house divided cannot stand.
quote: Melania is covered. Their marriage is good
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though praying against division in that marriage recurs and is worth tracking.
